description: Defines a template class 'scoped_resource' implementing RAII for resource management, along with helper classes and typedefs for managing pointers, arrays, and FILE pointers with automatic cleanup.

classes.name: scoped_resource
classes.description: Template class implementing RAII for managing resources with customizable release policies.

classes.name: scoped_ptr
classes.description: Template class managing a single object pointer with delete policy.

classes.name: scoped_array
classes.description: Template class managing an array pointer with delete[] policy.

classes.name: close_FILE
classes.description: Utility struct for closing FILE pointers.

methods.name: operator resource_type()
methods.description: Allows implicit conversion to the resource type.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Provides explicit access to the managed resource.

methods.name: operator->
methods.description: Provides pointer-like access if resource is a pointer.

methods.name: assign
methods.description: Releases current resource and assigns a new one.
